method: Monte Carlo (same mechanics as scripts/247's BASE-only forecast): real R1 score + remaining_rounds drawn from Normal(R1SG-model-predicted expectation, spread), ranked across the field. The R1SG model's expectation = final_coefficients.R1SG applied to (prior_avg_round_to_par, real R1 Strokes Gained total).
walk_forward_disclosure: R1SG model does NOT outperform the BASE-only model in walk-forward validation (event_wins tied 4-4 across 8 evaluated historical events, pooled MAE improvement 0.0035 strokes) -- the numbers below are a labeled alternative calculation, not a validated improvement over the already-published BASE-only forecast.
fr_assumption: same fitted R2-conditional expectation applied to FR (no separately-validated R1SG->FR model exists)
cut_probability_note: not touched by this script -- official cut rule for this 3-round tournament unconfirmed, see module docstring
spread_source: klpga_pipeline/data/klpga.sqlite player_round (own stdev if >= 3 real rounds, else population pstdev=3.3842) -- same as scripts/247, unchanged
